SELECT * FROM humanresources.employeepayhistory eph 
JOIN humanresources.employeedepartmenthistory edh ON eph.businessentityid = edh.businessentityid 
JOIN humanresources.department d ON edh.departmentid = d.departmentid 
WHERE d.name IN ('Information Services', 'Document Control')
ORDER BY d.name, eph.rate DESC
